viz_p25.title: TLS Certificate Time to Expiry (Keystore / Truststore)

options.query:
| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="container_memory_working_set_bytes" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$"  BY pod span=1m
| eval series="Usage"
| append [
| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kube_pod_container_resource_limits" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$" resource="memory" container="schemaregistry"  BY pod span=1m
| eval series="Limit"
]
| eval pod_series=series."-".pod
| timechart span=1m avg(value) by pod_series

| mstats sum(_value) as used WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="container_memory_working_set_bytes" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$"  BY pod span=1m
| append [
| mstats sum(_value) as capacity WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kube_pod_container_resource_limits" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$" resource="memory" container="schemaregistry"  BY pod span=1m
]
| stats latest(used) as used latest(capacity) as capacity by pod
| eval value=round(used/capacity*100,2)
| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="container_memory_working_set_bytes" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$"

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kube_pod_container_resource_limits" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$" resource="memory" container="schemaregistry"

| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="container_cpu_usage_seconds_total" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$"  BY pod span=1m
| streamstats current=f window=1 global=f last(value) as prev_value last(_time) as prev_time by pod
| eval value=if(isnotnull(prev_value) AND (_time-prev_time)>0, (value-prev_value)/(_time-prev_time), null())
| eval series="Usage"
| append [
| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kube_pod_container_resource_limits" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$" resource="cpu" container="schemaregistry"  BY pod span=1m
| eval series="Limit"
]
| eval pod_series=series."-".pod
| timechart span=1m avg(value) by pod_series

| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="container_cpu_usage_seconds_total" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$"  BY pod span=1m
| streamstats current=f window=1 global=f last(value) as prev_value last(_time) as prev_time by pod
| eval used=if(isnotnull(prev_value) AND (_time-prev_time)>0, (value-prev_value)/(_time-prev_time), null())
| append [
| mstats sum(_value) as capacity WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kube_pod_container_resource_limits" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$" resource="cpu" container="schemaregistry"  BY pod span=1m
]
| stats latest(used) as used latest(capacity) as capacity by pod
| eval value=round(used/capacity*100,2)

| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="container_cpu_usage_seconds_total" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$" span=1m
| streamstats current=f window=1 last(value) as prev_value last(_time) as prev_time
| eval rate=if(isnotnull(prev_value) AND (_time-prev_time)>0, (value-prev_value)/(_time-prev_time), null())
| stats latest(rate) as value

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kube_pod_container_resource_limits" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="$pod$" resource="cpu" container="schemaregistry"

| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_memory_bytes_used" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="schemaregistry" area="heap" service.instance.id="$pod$"  BY service.instance.id span=1m
| eval series="Usage"
| append [
| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_memory_bytes_max" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="schemaregistry" area="heap" service.instance.id="$pod$"  BY service.instance.id span=1m
| eval series="Limit"
]
| eval instance_series=series."-".'service.instance.id'
| timechart span=1m avg(value) by instance_series

| mstats avg(_value) as used WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_memory_bytes_used" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="schemaregistry" area="heap" service.instance.id="$pod$"  BY service.instance.id span=1m
| append [
| mstats avg(_value) as capacity WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_memory_bytes_max" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="schemaregistry" area="heap" service.instance.id="$pod$"  BY service.instance.id span=1m
]
| stats latest(used) as used latest(capacity) as capacity by service.instance.id
| eval value=round(used/capacity*100,2)

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_memory_bytes_used" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="schemaregistry" area="heap" service.instance.id="$pod$"

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_memory_bytes_max" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="schemaregistry" area="heap" service.instance.id="$pod$"

| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_gc_collection_seconds_sum" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="schemaregistry" service.instance.id="$pod$"  BY service.instance.id span=1m
| streamstats current=f window=1 global=f last(value) as prev_value last(_time) as prev_time by service.instance.id
| eval rate=if(isnotnull(prev_value) AND (_time-prev_time)>0, (value-prev_value)/(_time-prev_time), null())
| timechart span=1m avg(rate) by service.instance.id

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="jvm_threads_current" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="schemaregistry" service.instance.id="$pod$"

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_schema_registry_master_slave_role_master_slave_role" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="schemaregistry" service.instance.id="$pod$"

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_schema_registry_node_count_node_count" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="schemaregistry" service.instance.id="$pod$"

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_schema_registry_leader_initialization_latency_leader_initialization_latency" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="schemaregistry" service.instance.id="$pod$"

| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_schema_registry_registered_count_registered_count" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="schemaregistry" service.instance.id="$pod$" span=1m
| streamstats current=f window=1 last(value) as prev_value last(_time) as prev_time
| eval rate=if(isnotnull(prev_value) AND (_time-prev_time)>0, (value-prev_value)/(_time-prev_time), null()), series="registered"
| append [
| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_schema_registry_deleted_count_deleted_count" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="schemaregistry" service.instance.id="$pod$" span=1m
| streamstats current=f window=1 last(value) as prev_value last(_time) as prev_time
| eval rate=if(isnotnull(prev_value) AND (_time-prev_time)>0, (value-prev_value)/(_time-prev_time), null()), series="deleted"
]
| timechart span=1m avg(rate) by series

| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_schema_registry_avro_schemas_created_avro_schemas_created" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="schemaregistry" service.instance.id="$pod$" span=1m
| streamstats current=f window=1 last(value) as prev_value last(_time) as prev_time
| eval rate=if(isnotnull(prev_value) AND (_time-prev_time)>0, (value-prev_value)/(_time-prev_time), null()), series="avro"
| append [
| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_schema_registry_json_schemas_created_json_schemas_created" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="schemaregistry" service.instance.id="$pod$" span=1m
| streamstats current=f window=1 last(value) as prev_value last(_time) as prev_time
| eval rate=if(isnotnull(prev_value) AND (_time-prev_time)>0, (value-prev_value)/(_time-prev_time), null()), series="json"
]
| append [
| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_schema_registry_protobuf_schemas_created_protobuf_schemas_created" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="schemaregistry" service.instance.id="$pod$" span=1m
| streamstats current=f window=1 last(value) as prev_value last(_time) as prev_time
| eval rate=if(isnotnull(prev_value) AND (_time-prev_time)>0, (value-prev_value)/(_time-prev_time), null()), series="protobuf"
]
| timechart span=1m avg(rate) by series

| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_schema_registry_api_success_count_api_success_count" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="schemaregistry" service.instance.id="$pod$" span=1m
| streamstats current=f window=1 last(value) as prev_value last(_time) as prev_time
| eval rate=if(isnotnull(prev_value) AND (_time-prev_time)>0, (value-prev_value)/(_time-prev_time), null()), series="success"
| append [
| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_schema_registry_api_failure_count_api_failure_count" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="schemaregistry" service.instance.id="$pod$" span=1m
| streamstats current=f window=1 last(value) as prev_value last(_time) as prev_time
| eval rate=if(isnotnull(prev_value) AND (_time-prev_time)>0, (value-prev_value)/(_time-prev_time), null()), series="failure"
]
| timechart span=1m avg(rate) by series

| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_schema_registry_certificate_expiration_keystore_certificate_expiration_keystore" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="schemaregistry" service.instance.id="$pod$" span=1m
| eval series="keystore"
| append [
| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kafka_schema_registry_certificate_expiration_truststore_certificate_expiration_truststore" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" service.name="schemaregistry" service.instance.id="$pod$" span=1m

]
| timechart span=1m avg(value) by series

title: Confluent Schema Registry Resources (Memory, CPU, JVM)
description: Per-pod container resource usage, JVM heap/GC/thread metrics, and Schema Registry domain metrics (leader role, schema registration/deletion rate, schema format breakdown, API success/failure rate, TLS certificate expiry) for Schema Registry pods in the confluent namespace.
